excerpts.anchor: Magnesium is an essential mineral that is critical in numerous physiological processes
marks: magnesium stabilizes ATP, the primary energy currency of the cell

excerpts.anchor: The etiology of hypomagnesemia is multifactorial
marks: Medications such as loop diuretics (e.g., furosemide) and thiazide diuretics can increase urinary excretion of magnesium, leading to depletion.
